```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(rhdf5)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(scRepertoire)
library(BiocParallel)
library(scDblFinder)
h5ad_file <- "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/CTCL_all_final_portal_tags.h5ad"

# Convert the `.h5ad` file to `.h5Seurat` format
#Convert(h5ad_file, dest = "h5Seurat", overwrite = TRUE)

sobj <- LoadH5Seurat(file="~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/CTCL_all_final_portal_tags.h5seurat",  meta.data = FALSE, misc = FALSE)
obs <- h5read("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/CTCL_all_final_portal_tags.h5seurat", "/meta.data")

meta <- data.frame(lapply(names(obs), function(x) { 
  if (length(obs[[x]])==2) 
    obs[[x]][['categories']][ifelse(obs[[x]][['codes']] >= 0, obs[[x]][['codes']] + 1, NA)]
  else 
    as.numeric(obs[[x]])
}
), row.names=Cells(sobj))
colnames(meta) <- names(obs)

sobj <- AddMetaData(sobj, meta)

table(sobj$donor)

```

```{r}
# List of CTCL numbers (1 to 8)
ctcl_numbers <- 1:8

# Initialize an empty list to store the data
file_list <- list()

# Loop through each CTCL number
for (i in ctcl_numbers) {
  # Check the number of files for the current CTCL (3 or 4 files)
  for (j in 1:4) {
    file_path <- paste0("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/CTCL_vdj/filtered_contig_annotations_CTCL", i, "_VDJ", j, ".csv")
    
    # Check if the file exists
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      # Read the CSV file and store it in the list
      file_name <- paste0("S", i, ".", j)  # Create a dynamic variable name
      file_list[[file_name]] <- read.csv(file_path)
    }
  }
}

# Check the structure of file_list to verify
str(file_list)
```

```{r}
unique(keep$donor_and_number)

#ss <- subset(keep, donor_and_number == "CTCL2_31")

samples <- unique(keep$donor_and_number)
# Precompute barcode_simple subsets for all samples to avoid repeated subsetting
sample_barcodes <- lapply(samples, function(sample) {
  subset(keep, donor_and_number == sample)$barcode_simple
})

# Name the list by sample for easier reference
names(sample_barcodes) <- samples

# Use sapply to compute overlaps, minimizing repetitive operations
overlap_counts_df <- sapply(file_list, function(df) {
  sapply(sample_barcodes, function(barcodes) {
    # Use fast vectorized set operations
    length(intersect(barcodes, df$barcode))
  })
})

```


```{r}
# Ensure overlap_counts_df is a matrix or dataframe
overlap_counts_df <- as.data.frame(overlap_counts_df)
rownames(overlap_counts_df) <- samples

# Convert to the desired format
result <- apply(overlap_counts_df, 1, function(row) {
  # Find the column (file_list item) with the maximum count
  max_col <- names(row)[which.max(row)]
  max_count <- max(row)
  c(max_col, max_count)
})

# Convert the result to a dataframe
result_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(overlap_counts_df),
  MaxColumn = result[1, ],
  MaxCount = as.numeric(result[2, ])
)

# Display the result
print(result_df)



filtered_result_df <- result_df %>%
  group_by(MaxColumn) %>%
  filter(MaxCount == max(MaxCount)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # In case of ties, take the first one
  ungroup()

# Display the filtered dataframe
print(filtered_result_df)

file_list.save <- file_list

saveRDS(file_list.save, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/file_list.save.rds")
```




```{r}
file_list <- lapply(names(file_list), function(name) {
  # Get the corresponding sample name from filtered_result_df for the current file
  sample_name <- filtered_result_df$Sample[filtered_result_df$MaxColumn == name]
  
  # Append the sample name to the barcodes in the current file
  file_list[[name]]$barcode <- paste0(file_list[[name]]$barcode, "_", sample_name)
  
  # Return the updated dataframe
  file_list[[name]]
})
```

```{r}
plot(ctcl.new.final$nFeature_RNA[1:1000], ctcl.new.final$nFeature_RNA_manual[1:1000])


VlnPlot(ctcl.new.final, features = "nFeature_RNA", pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(ctcl.new.final, features = "nFeature_RNA_manual", pt.size = 0)

df <- data.frame("auto" = ctcl.new.final$nFeature_RNA, "man" = ctcl.new.final$nFeature_RNA_manual)
df$dif <- df$auto - df$man
max(df$dif)

ctcl.new.final$nFeature_RNA <- ctcl.new.final$nFeature_RNA_manual

list <- list[9:18]
for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- subset(ctcl.new.final, donor == list[i])
  tmp <- subset(tmp, subset = nFeature_RNA > 100) #filter out low count/feature cells
  tmp[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(tmp, pattern = "^MT-")
  tmp[["percent.rb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(tmp, pattern = "^RBS|RPL")
  standev <- sd(log(tmp$nFeature_RNA))*2 #cutting off above standard deviation of 2
  mean <- mean(log(tmp$nFeature_RNA))
  cut <- round(exp(standev+mean))
  tmp <- subset(tmp, subset = percent.mt < 15 & nFeature_RNA < cut)
  sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(tmp)
  sce <- scDblFinder(sce, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(16))
  doublets <- data.frame(db.class = sce$scDblFinder.class, db.score = sce$scDblFinder.score)
  rownames(doublets) <- rownames(sce@colData)
  tmp <- AddMetaData(tmp, doublets)
  new.seurat.list[i+8] <- tmp
}

list <- unique(ctcl.new.final$donor)

names(new.seurat.list) <- list

final.all <- merge(new.seurat.list[[1]], new.seurat.list[-1])

table(final.all$donor)
saveRDS(final.all, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/SO_ctcl.new.final.filtered.rds")
```

# Skin Cell Atlas
```{r}
# Skin Cell Atlas
cells <- read.csv("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/cells.csv")
genes <- read.csv("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/genes.csv")

rownames(cells) <- cells$index

mat <- readMM("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/matrix.mtx")
mat <- t(mat)
mat@Dimnames <- list(genes$index, cells$index)

sobj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat)
sobj@meta.data <- cells


table(sobj.ss$final_clustering)
df <- data.frame(sobj$final_clustering)
df$barcode <- rownames(df)
df.ss <- df %>%
  group_by(sobj.final_clustering) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 500)
table(df.ss$sobj.final_clustering)


sobj.ss <- subset(sobj, index %in% df.ss$barcode)

sobj.ss <- FindVariableFeatures(sobj.ss)
sobj.ss <- NormalizeData(sobj.ss)
sobj.ss <- ScaleData(sobj.ss)
sobj.ss <- RunPCA(sobj.ss)
sobj.ss <- RunHarmony(sobj.ss, group.by.vars = "donor_id", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "RNA", reduction.save = "harmony", ncores = 30)
sobj.ss <- RunUMAP(sobj.ss, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(sobj.ss, group.by = "donor_id")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(sobj.ss, group.by = "Site", shuffle = T)
DimPlot(sobj.ss, group.by = "Status", shuffle = T)
DimPlot(sobj.ss, group.by = "final_clustering", label = T)+NoLegend()
saveRDS(sobj.ss, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/skin_cell_atlas_SO.rds")
```
